Admission Date: 2026-09-15 Discharge Date: 2026-09-20 Service: MEDICINE
Chief Complaint: Shortness of breath, chest tightness, productive cough.
History of Present Illness: 68-year-old female patient with a history of COPD and essential hypertension presenting with worsening dyspnea and purulent sputum for 3 days.
Past Medical History: 1. Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) 2. Essential Hypertension 3. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
Medications on Admission: Lisinopril 10mg PO daily, Metformin 1000mg PO BID, Albuterol inhaler PRN.
Discharge Medications: 1. Prednisone 40 mg PO daily for 5 days 2. Azithromycin 500 mg PO daily for 5 days 3. Lisinopril 10 mg PO daily.
Discharge Diagnosis: Acute exacerbation of COPD, Essential hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

Admission Date: 2026-09-18 Discharge Date: 2026-09-22 Service: CARDIOLOGY
Chief Complaint: Palpitations, dizziness, fatigue.
History of Present Illness: 72-year-old male presenting with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and elevated blood pressure.
Past Medical History: Atrial Fibrillation, Coronary Artery Disease, Hyperlipidemia.
Discharge Medications: 1. Apixaban 5 mg PO BID 2. Metoprolol Succinate 50 mg PO daily 3. Atorvastatin 40 mg PO daily.
Discharge Diagnosis: Atrial Fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, Essential Hypertension.
